script: Astronauts say space has a smell. After spacewalks, they notice it on their suits and gear. Many describe it as seared steak, hot metal or welding fumes. Moon dust brought inside smelled like spent gunpowder. The smell may come from reactive oxygen atoms clinging to the suits. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
